scope: Packaged material 2036 through Xbox Device8 slot 115, state link and dispatch. A separately assembled desktop DXR hit group supplies the same local geometry, sampler and texture inputs. Compared full payloads for two sides of each instance and a miss.
observations: Four hits preserve packed texture RGB (.25,.5,1), the native literal half-NaN fields in words 4/5 and the per-instance payload tag. The geometric miss preserves its seeded words. All 80 words matched on each GPU. In the same run the 15 opaque and three masked materials matched for all 96 rays (1,536 words) on each adapter.
limits: Controlled descriptors and page inputs; identical DXR/guest outputs use the same translated material shader.
